data: Which of the following is true about the number of questions and users?

The graph shows two lines representing the number of users and the number of questions over time. The red line represents the number of users, while the blue line represents the number of questions. Both lines show an increasing trend over time. However, the number of questions remains relatively constant at around 10,407 throughout the period, while the number of users increases significantly from approximately 208,744 to 878,896. Therefore, the statement that is true about the number of questions and users is that the number of users increases more than the number of questions.
